newsitem.title: USA: Investor has 6.6 pct of RehabCare.
newsitem.headline: Investor has 6.6 pct of RehabCare.

text.p: Robert Horowitz, a Glen Rock, N.J., investor, and entities he controls, said Tuesday that they have acquired 308,600 shares of RehabCare Group Inc., or 6.6 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Horowitz group said it acquired the stake for investment purposes in open market purchases at a total cost of about $5.8 million.
The group said it bought 138,600 of the shares between Jan. 17 and Feb. 10 at prices ranging from $19.425 to $21.500 a share.
